parameters.name: ParentCategoryId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent category. The new category is created under this parent category. If this value is left empty, the new category is of the first level.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-meta-category --tid 3000 --name default --parent-category-id 30000322682 --description test --remark 21212 --owner-ids 510000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise CreateMetaCategory --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --Tid 3000 --ParentCategoryId 30000322682 --OwnerIds '[510000]' --Name default --Remark 21212
